news.h: Jaguars thrash the depleted Ravens 33-10 for their 5th win in 6 games
news.d: — Trevor Lawrence threw for 242 yards and a touchdown, and the Jacksonville Jaguars had little trouble with Joe Fagnano and the Baltimore Ravens in a 33-10 victory Thursday night.

news.h: Trevor Lawrence, Jags pull away from Joe Fagnano, Ravens on TNF
news.d: The Jaguars never trailed in a comfortable win over the short-handed Ravens in Baltimore.

news.h: Ravens are down to their No. 3 quarterback with the AFC South-leading Jaguars in town
news.d: — Joe Fagnano's NFL career is beginning with two games in five days. There's not a lot of time to stop and think.

news.h: Latest on Baltimore's QB room and kicker situation
news.d: Report: the latest on quarterback Joe Fagnano and kicker Jake Moody rising up the depth chart due to injuries.

news.h: Rookie Joe Fagnano to start Thursday night vs. Jaguars, Jesse Minter says
news.d: Ravens rookie quarterback Joe Fagnano will start Thursday night's game against the Jaguars, coach Jesse Minter announced Tuesday.
